question: Two trains, 248 m and 142 m in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 34 km/hr and the second at the rate of 74 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add

Total speed = 34 + 74 = 108 km/hr = 30 m/s

Total distance = 248 + 142 = 390 m

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 390 ÷ 30 = 13 sec

**∴ Answer = 13 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of trains = 248 m and 142 m

Speeds = 34 km/hr and 74 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 248 + 142 = 390 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = 34 + 74 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed ⇒ 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

⇒ Time = 390 ÷ 30 = 13 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 13 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add, Same direction ⇒ speeds subtract.

Train Crossing Rule

Total distance = sum of lengths when two trains cross each other.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.
